user.title: Connect to BetterDisplay
user.description: Enter the address of the Mac running BetterDisplay. Enable Settings > Application > Integration > "Enable integrated HTTP server" in BetterDisplay first.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach BetterDisplay's HTTP integration at that host/port. Make sure BetterDisplay is running and Settings > Application > Integration > "Enable integrated HTTP server" is on.

abort.already_configured: This BetterDisplay instance is already configured.
